sourceObjectSnapshot.name: Druid · UA high levels
sourceObjectSnapshot.description: UA extends the druid hierarchy through Grand Druid and a separate Hierophant progression. The XP reset makes a simple level-1 cumulative array unsuitable.
guidance: The Grand Druid is level 15, with at least 3,000,001 XP; the office carries special responsibilities and benefits.
After at least 3,500,001 XP, a Grand Druid may seek a successor and abdicate.
On entering the level-16 Hierophant path, the XP total resets to 1 and office-related bonus spells are relinquished.
Use the separate Hierophant table and planar abilities; do not extrapolate the PHB druid table.

changes: After at least 3,500,001 XP as Grand Druid, find a successor and abdicate to enter the Hierophant path: reset XP to 1 and relinquish the office-related extra spell levels.
Spell-slot maxima stay at six per spell level; future advancement changes casting level and grants special powers instead of additional slots.
Gain immunity to natural animal/vegetable poisons (including monster poisons), but not mineral poisons or poison gas; gain 160 extra years of life and vigorous health.

You can alter appearance non-magically in 1 segment: height and weight up to 50% either way, apparent age from child to very old, and human/humanoid features; true seeing or similar perception can reveal it.

For elemental conjuring, UA replaces the earth results and supplies further tables. A roll equal to or below your level as a percentage selects the desired creature type; otherwise roll the appropriate result normally.

changes: Druid casting level increases 16 → 17; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 160 → 170 years.
Gain hibernation/suspended animation without aging for up to the longevity period (170 years at this level).
Gain entry to the Elemental Plane of Earth at will; transfer takes 1 round. Planar entry also makes the environment natural to you, with no time limit for remaining.
Gain conjure water elemental once per day; use the UA conjuring procedure and result table.

changes: Druid casting level increases 17 → 18; daily slots remain six at each spell level 1–7. Extra longevity increases 170 → 180 years.
Gain entry to the Elemental Plane of Fire under the Earth-entry procedure, including its 1-round transfer and survival benefits.
Gain conjure air elemental once per day.
Add 1 fixed hit point: the table changes accumulated hp from 15 hit dice +2 to 15 hit dice +3.
